build_hunyuan3d2_pipeline: build a Hunyuan3D 2.0 image-to-mesh pipeline with shape and optional paint stages
create_pipeline_stages: create pipeline stages for shape denoising, export, save, and optional paint processing
load_hunyuan3d_modules: load Hunyuan3D shape components including DiT model, VAE, conditioner, scheduler, and image processor
resolve_shape_model_dir: resolve shape model directory path and download from HuggingFace Hub if not found locally
load_checkpoint_split: load and split a bundled checkpoint file into per-component weight dictionaries
